facts.fact: The queen's warrant for Ittan bears the same green sunbird seal as the payment writ, including the chip at the left wing tip. Devan notices and says nothing.
facts.why: needed because it ties the crown's justice to the queen's seal and raises Devan's wariness without adding a plot fact.

facts.fact: The escort are called First, Second, Third and Fourth Guard. First Guard is a woman about Devan's age with a pale finger-long ridge on the inside of her left wrist.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a First Guard whose cuff shows a scar Devan reads as a lamp-burn.

facts.fact: Bhaskaran's horn code: one long note and two short means unarmed strangers at the gate, not many.
facts.why: needed because the beat opens on Bhaskaran's horn.

facts.fact: Rema takes the warden's chair in the hall. Janu quarters the escort in the south range. Rema's First Guard stands at Ittan's guardroom door beside Bhaskaran's men.
facts.why: needed because Devan must be outranked inside his own fort.

facts.fact: Rema grants an assize at Kettamala in three days, with Ittan heard as witness; she decides afterwards whether she carries out a traitor, a witness or no one.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Rema to grant a hearing in three days.
